purpose: Prospective exact representable coupled patches; no production promotion or general convergence claim
sampling: solid quadrature samples with 0.25<=x<=0.75; max tensor component error divided by declared nonzero stress scale

poisson_membrane.left_prescription: exact shell field at x=-1; all six DOFs
poisson_membrane.loads: right native edge uniform force_x total1N; other physical external surfaces traction-free

in_plane_shear.left_prescription: exact shell field at x=-1; all six DOFs
in_plane_shear.loads: right native edge force_y total tau*t*width=.2N; y=1 physical side traction_x=+tau and y=0 traction_x=-tau; native side edge equivalent line force_x=+/-tau*t integrated consistently

transverse_shear.preflight_reason: Native production E4-PL uses As=(5/6)*t*G. This constant 3D shear field would require uncorrected As=t*G. No numerical result or pass is claimed; replace with independently registered compatible parabolic-shear/Timoshenko convergence case without changing tolerances.
transverse_shear.left_prescription: exact shell field at x=-1; all six DOFs including theta_y
transverse_shear.loads: right native edge force_z total tau*t*width=.2N; solid z=+t/2 traction_x=+tau, z=-t/2 traction_x=-tau; each native shell area gets uniform distributed moment_y density tau*t integrated as consistent nodal moments

twist.left_prescription: exact shell field at x=-1; all six DOFs
twist.loads: M=E*a*t^3/12=.0006666666666666668; right native edge total moment_x=-M; solid y=1 traction_x=+E*a*z and y=0 traction_x=-E*a*z; native y=1 side edge moment_y line density +M, y=0 -M

reference_policy: Closed-form isotropic 3D continuum fields and matching physical shell traces. Keep prescribed nonzero reference fields and all required external surfaces; do not substitute K*u loads or retune fields to obtain a pass. Record failures and stop promotion.
